title: Share the Toys
subtitle: What happens at recess when everyone wants the same thing?
description: It is recess and everyone wants to play with the one ball on the playground. What will you do when your friend, a new kid, and even a bully all want a turn?
learning_objectives: Understand that sharing makes playtime better for everyone
Practice seeing a situation from another child's point of view
Discover creative ways to include others in play
reflection_prompt: How did it feel when you chose to share? Would you do the same thing again?

scenes.title: One Ball, Many Kids
scenes.narration: The school bell rings for recess. You grab the class ball from the shelf. Outside, three other kids are already waiting: your best friend Arjun, a new girl named Zoe, and Ravi who sometimes takes things without asking.

choices.label: Play only with Arjun — he is your best friend
Keep the ball and play alone

scenes.narration: You and Arjun kick the ball happily. Zoe watches from the side, looking left out. Ravi shouts that it is not fair.

choices.label: Wave Zoe over to join you two
Keep playing — it is just Arjun and you today

scenes.narration: You call everyone into a circle. Even Ravi looks surprised. Zoe grins and says, 'I know a game called Piggy in the Middle — want to try?'

choices.label: Stick to the game you know

scenes.narration: You dribble by yourself near the wall. After two minutes it feels boring. Arjun walks over looking sad.

choices.label: Invite Arjun to play with you

scenes.narration: Piggy in the Middle is hilarious. Even Ravi laughs when he is the piggy. By the end of recess everyone is a little out of breath and smiling.
scenes.outcome_summary: You turned one ball into a game for everyone. That is what good leaders do — they make more room, not less.

scenes.narration: The group grows to three, then four. Ravi turns out to be a great goalkeeper. You finish recess with new friends.
scenes.outcome_summary: Opening up the game made it more fun for everyone, including you.

scenes.narration: You and Arjun have fun, but Zoe sits alone the whole recess. On the way back inside, you notice she is quiet.
scenes.outcome_summary: It is okay to play with your best friend — just notice when someone is left out. There is usually room for one more.

scenes.narration: Recess passes slowly. When the bell rings you walk in alone. It was your ball, but sharing it might have made it more fun.
scenes.outcome_summary: Sharing a toy does not mean losing it — it usually means a better game.
